response.sql:
SELECT
  mt.Name AS MediaTypeName,
  AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS AverageListPricePerTrack,
  AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS AverageBytesPerMillisecond
FROM Track AS t
JOIN MediaType AS mt
  ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
GROUP BY mt.Name;

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with NULL Bytes are excluded by the size threshold; SQL AVG ignores NULL values in each averaged expression.
